issues.title: Submodules held in a plain list are never registered
issues.message: self.blocks is a plain list comprehension of model.ConvBlock (line 34), so none of the submodules it builds is registered on SmallCNN.
issues.why: A plain list is invisible to nn.Module, so those layers never appear in parameters(), the optimizer never updates them and .to(device) leaves them behind - the network trains with most of itself frozen.
issues.fixHint: Wrap the container in nn.ModuleList([...]) or nn.ModuleDict({...}) so the submodules are registered as children.

issues.title: Gradients are never zeroed
issues.message: The batch loop at train.py:29 calls loss.backward() (line 32) and optimizer.step() (line 33) but never zero_grad(). Gradients accumulate across batches.
issues.why: Accumulated gradients make each update the sum of all previous batches, so training diverges or converges to the wrong place - silently.
issues.fixHint: Call optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) as the first statement of the training step, before the forward pass.

issues.title: Softmax applied before CrossEntropyLoss
issues.message: The value passed to criterion() at train.py:31 comes from torch.nn.functional.softmax at model.py:43, so the probabilities are log-softmaxed twice.
issues.why: CrossEntropyLoss applies log-softmax internally, so a second softmax flattens the gradients and the model trains far worse than it should.
issues.fixHint: Return raw logits from forward() and apply softmax only where you need probabilities for reporting.

issues.title: Training DataLoader does not shuffle
issues.message: The training DataLoader at data.py:33 is built with shuffle= unset (it defaults to False) and no sampler=, so train_ds is consumed in dataset order every epoch.
issues.why: Batches arrive in dataset order, so gradients are correlated with however the files were sorted and the model can learn the ordering instead of the task.
issues.fixHint: Pass shuffle=True to the training DataLoader, or give it a shuffling sampler such as RandomSampler / DistributedSampler.

issues.title: DataLoader worker processes without a __main__ guard
issues.message: DataLoader(num_workers=4) at data.py:33, but the loader is constructed at module scope and the module has no if __name__ == "__main__" guard - on Windows and macOS every worker re-imports data.py.
issues.why: Windows and macOS start workers with spawn, so each worker re-imports the module; without a guard the module-level training code runs again in every worker and the program hangs or recurses.
issues.fixHint: Move the entrypoint into a function and call it from if __name__ == "__main__": main().

issues.title: Evaluation loop not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
issues.message: The evaluation region at train.py:44 builds an autograd graph it never uses: the loop at line 44 over loader runs a forward pass, never calls backward() or optimizer.step(), and it sits in validate().
issues.why: Autograd keeps every intermediate activation alive for a backward pass that never happens, so evaluation uses several times the memory it needs and can run out of GPU memory on a larger batch.
issues.fixHint: Wrap the evaluation loop in with torch.no_grad(): (or torch.inference_mode()), or decorate the function with @torch.no_grad().

issues.title: Split without random_state / generator
issues.message: random_split at data.py:31 takes no generator=, so the split is different on every run.
issues.why: A different split every run means the reported score moves for reasons that have nothing to do with the model, and a regression cannot be told from noise.
issues.fixHint: Pass random_state=42 (scikit-learn) or generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(42) (PyTorch) so the split is reproducible independently of global RNG state.
